name: Gas-interrupter breaker reference
summary: Identifies a breaker application using the documented gas-interruption construction.
description: Identifies a breaker application using the documented gas-interruption construction. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Power path and mechanism command” at the input and “Interrupted gas-breaker path” at the output. Insulation medium and interruption medium need identification.
